items.title: U.S. added just 29,000 jobs in September, with unemployment rate rising to 4.2%
items.summary: Bitcoin held earlier gains following the report, up more than 2% over the past 24 hours and just below $87,000.

items.title: BitGo CEO says Clarity’s failure left capital markets exposed to risk potentially worse than Lehman
items.summary: BitGo CEO Mike Belshe warned that Clarity's failure left systemic risks arising from one firm holding exchange, brokerage, and custody functions.

items.title: Circle urges EU to revise stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review
items.summary: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.

items.title: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?
items.summary: Hacks are never good, but a rapid response, user compensation and 1-hour bug fixing seems to top the spectrum of team reactions.
